annotations.title: Hold an ad change for a person to confirm

description: Put an ad change on HOLD for a person to confirm instead of making it now. Pass tool (the ad write you would have called, for example set_meta_campaign_status, update_meta_object, set_google_ads_budget, set_tiktok_ads_status, delete_linkedin_ads_object) and args (exactly the arguments you would have sent, without confirm). Nothing reaches the ad platform. The person confirms or discards it in the Hermoso app (Schedule, Autopilot, Needs review), or you call confirm_ad_change after they agree. Use it when the user wants to review ad changes before they go live, or for any change you are not sure they want made now. The reply says what will change and, for a Meta campaign, ad set or ad or a Google campaign, its current values. Only writes to an ad account can be staged; reads and dry runs cannot. Staging the same call twice returns the first. Free.

args.description: the arguments that tool takes, exactly as you would send them (no confirm)

note.description: why, shown to the person who confirms (optional)

tool.description: the ad write tool to run later, e.g. set_meta_campaign_status
